newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hermes H1 net attrib profit up 7.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hermes H1 net attrib profit up 7.5 pct.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)
NOTE - Luxury goods firm Hermes gave its half-year results in a statement.
Net attributable profit rose 7.5 percent. At constant exchange rates, the rise was 17.6 percent.
Turnover rose 5.7 percent. At constant exchange rates and on a like for like basis, sales would have been up 7.9 percent.
Hermes ready-to-wear watches and perfumes showed double-digit sales growth, while the yen's weakness contributed to a six percent drop in silk scarf sales.
Retail sales in France were flat but higher in the United States and Asia.
The financial result showed a 15 million franc improvement.

Investments totalled 339 million francs in the first half, including 258 million francs for the takeover of Hermes's Japanese subsidiary. Investment was expected to remain at similar levels in the second half.
